summary.text: Joe Statler is a Republican member of the West Virginia House of Delegates, representing District 77, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists him as a former coal miner with Consolidated Coal Company who previously chaired the Morgantown-Monongalia Metropolitan Planning Organization.

paragraphs.text: Joe Statler was born in Morgantown, West Virginia, lives in Core, West Virginia, and graduated from Clay-Battelle High School.
His career experience includes working as a coal miner with Consolidated Coal Company, and he has served as chairman of the Morgantown-Monongalia Metropolitan Planning Organization.
Statler served in the House of Delegates from District 51 from 2015 to 2018, and Ballotpedia lists his current tenure as beginning in 2020.
He has represented District 77 since December 1, 2022, and advanced from the Republican primary on May 12, 2026.
